name: B10-0348/2026 (Renew) – The abduction, forced conversion and child marriage of Maria Shahbaz and the protection of girls in Pakistan
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the abduction, forced conversion and child marriage of Maria Shahbaz and the protection of girls in Pakistan
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and making requests. It condemns the abduction, forced conversion and child marriage of Maria Shahbaz, a thirteen-year-old girl, and asks Pakistan's authorities to review her case independently and keep her safe. It also asks Pakistan to investigate and prosecute these crimes, to stop courts approving marriages or conversions of minors, and to protect girls from religious minorities. It asks the European Union to raise these issues with Pakistan.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; these are requests, not binding decisions.
- **Who it affects:** Pakistan's government and courts, and girls from minority communities there.
- **What happens next:** The EU is asked to raise the case in its human rights talks with Pakistan.
